general_information.name: OH—MY NAME? UM, I THINK IT’S MARGARET, BUT YOU MEAN THE FULL ONE ON DOCUMENTS… I’M NOT SURE I’M SAYING IT RIGHT. COULD YOU REPEAT THAT, OR DO YOU WANT THE FULL FIRST AND LAST NAME TOGETHER?
general_information.address: Oh, the address—well, I know the street part, but the rest always slips my mind when I’m put on the spot. Could you break it down for me, like street first, then the rest?

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly it’s the back pain, the lower back, since that injury at work in 2019… and lately my mood’s been low too, sleeping badly, not feeling interested in much. I’ve stopped going to church and the social group as well.
current_concerns.goals: I want the pain managed better, and… I’d like to get back to my choir.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born in Trinidad and moved to Toronto when I was 14… I remember it as a warm household. That’s really what comes to mind first.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I finished high school in Toronto and started working when I was 20. That’s about it, really.
personal_history.significant_relationships: Well… I was married, and my husband died. We were married for 28 years. There isn’t anything current, and my three adult children live nearby.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to be well enough to look after my grandchildren.
